articles.title: JPMorgan Deploys AI Underwriting Engine Across 40 Markets
articles.summary: JPMorgan Chase has rolled out its AI-powered credit underwriting platform to 40 global markets, using large language models to synthesize earnings reports, macro signals, and borrower history into real-time risk scores.

articles.title: SEC Proposes Mandatory AI Disclosure Rules for Hedge Funds
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission has put forward a rule requiring hedge funds managing over $1B to disclose material AI-driven trading strategies, including model lineage and backtesting methodology.

articles.title: Visa Launches Real-Time Fraud Neural Network Processing 800M Daily Transactions
articles.summary: Visa's new Cognitive Fraud Intelligence network replaces its previous rules-based system with a transformer model that evaluates 500+ behavioral signals per transaction, reducing false positives by 38%.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Autonomous Trading Desk Generates $2.1B in Q1 Revenue
articles.summary: Goldman's AI-driven quantitative trading unit outperformed its human counterparts for the third consecutive quarter, with autonomous systems now executing 73% of the bank's fixed-income trades.

articles.title: Lemonade's AI Claims Adjudicator Settles Policies in Under 3 Seconds
articles.summary: InsurTech leader Lemonade reports its next-gen AI adjudicator now processes 94% of property claims without human review, using computer vision and NLP to assess damage photos and policy documents simultaneously.

articles.title: ECB Publishes Framework for AI Risk in Systemically Important Banks
articles.summary: The European Central Bank released its long-awaited guidance on AI governance for G-SIBs, requiring explainability audits, model inventory registries, and independent AI risk committees at board level by 2027.

articles.title: Stripe Acquires AI Financial Forecasting Startup Parity for $890M
articles.summary: Stripe has acquired Parity, a YC-backed startup that built cash-flow forecasting models for SMBs. The technology will be integrated into Stripe's revenue intelligence dashboard, available to 4M+ merchants.

articles.title: BlackRock Aladdin 3.0 Integrates Multimodal AI for Portfolio Construction
articles.summary: BlackRock's Aladdin platform upgrade adds multimodal AI capabilities, allowing portfolio managers to query market data, earnings call audio, and satellite imagery within a single co-pilot interface.

articles.title: CFPB Warns Against AI Chatbots Providing Unlicensed Financial Advice
articles.summary: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau issued a supervisory bulletin cautioning banks that AI chatbots dispensing personalized investment or credit recommendations may violate licensing and disclosure requirements.

articles.title: Klarna AI Customer Service Handles 87% of Interactions Without Human Escalation
articles.summary: Buy-now-pay-later giant Klarna reported its AI assistant now manages nearly nine in ten customer service interactions, equivalent to 700 full-time agents, while maintaining CSAT scores above pre-AI benchmarks.

articles.title: Citadel Securities Builds Proprietary LLM for Equity Research Synthesis
articles.summary: Citadel Securities confirmed it has trained an in-house large language model on 20 years of sell-side research, earnings transcripts, and trade flow data to generate differentiated alpha signals ahead of earnings seasons.

articles.title: HSBC AI KYC Platform Cuts Onboarding Time From 14 Days to 4 Hours
articles.summary: HSBC's global rollout of its AI-powered Know Your Customer platform uses document intelligence and adverse media screening to compress corporate client onboarding from two weeks to under four hours.
